name: Magizh
description: Magizh Dairy Private Limited (suppliers, production, stock, customers management app)

paragraphs: A full‑stack web application for a real‑world dairy factory, built with Next.js and MongoDB. It handles daily production, supplier procurement, customer orders, inventory (stock), payments, and analytics – all in one place.
features: Production Management – Record daily milk processing and by‑products (curd, butter, ghee, paneer, cream) with automatic stock updates.
Supplier Management – Add suppliers, track milk procurement, rates (TS/fat), and due payments.
Customer Management – Manage customer details, product‑wise rates, and GST information.
Order Management – Create and edit customer orders with optional stock deduction, GST support, and invoice generation (PDF).
Stock Management – Real‑time stock levels with a full ledger of all movements (production, orders, adjustments). Minimum stock thresholds for alerts.
